tools.name: Word Counter
tools.summary: Students, writers, and social media managers constantly need to check word and character limits for essays, posts, captions, and SEO meta descriptions.
tools.title: Word Counter — Free Online Word & Character Count Tool
tools.description: Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs instantly. Free online word counter with no signup, no limits, works offline in your browser.
tools.intro: Word counter is a free online tool that counts words, characters, sentences, and paragraphs in your text as you type. Whether you are writing an essay for school, crafting a social media post, or optimizing a meta description for SEO, knowing your exact word count helps you stay within platform limits. The tool works entirely in your browser — no signup, no installation, and no data ever leaves your device. Everything runs locally using JavaScript for complete privacy and instant results.

faq.q: Does this word counter save my text?
faq.a: No. Everything runs in your browser's memory. When you close or refresh the page, your text is gone.

faq.q: Can I use this tool offline?
faq.a: Yes. Once the page loads, the word counter works without an internet connection.

faq.q: Does it count characters with or without spaces?
faq.a: Both. You get separate counts for characters including spaces and characters excluding spaces.

tools.name: Password Generator
tools.summary: With data breaches in the news constantly, people need to create unique passwords for new accounts and update old ones regularly.
tools.title: Password Generator — Create Strong Random Passwords Online
tools.description: Generate strong, secure random passwords instantly. Customize length, characters, and more. Free online password generator with no signup.
tools.intro: Password generator creates strong, random passwords that protect your online accounts from unauthorized access. You can customize the length and choose which character types to include — uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols. Every password is generated locally in your browser using cryptographically secure random number generation, so your passwords are never sent over the internet or stored anywhere. Create unlimited passwords for free with no signup required. The tool works on any device with a modern web browser and runs completely offline after the page loads.

faq.q: Is this password generator safe to use?
faq.a: Yes. Passwords are generated using your browser's built-in cryptographically secure random number generator and never leave your device.

faq.q: What makes a password strong?
faq.a: A strong password is at least 12 characters long and includes a mix of uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols.

faq.q: Can I use the same password everywhere?
faq.a: No. Use a unique password for every account so a breach on one site does not compromise your other accounts.

faq.q: What unit categories can I convert?

faq.q: How accurate are the conversions?

faq.q: Is there a limit to how many conversions I can do?
faq.a: No. You can convert as many values as you want for free.

tools.name: JSON Formatter
tools.summary: Developers work with JSON data daily — APIs return it, config files use it, and debugging requires reading minified JSON.
tools.title: JSON Formatter — Free Online JSON Validator & Beautifier
tools.description: Format, validate, and beautify your JSON data instantly. Free online JSON formatter with syntax highlighting and error detection. No signup.
tools.intro: JSON formatter is a free online tool that formats, validates, and beautifies JSON data. Paste your minified or messy JSON into the editor and get clean, readable, properly indented output in seconds. The tool highlights syntax, detects errors with precise line numbers, and helps you spot missing commas, brackets, or quotes. Whether you are debugging an API response, cleaning up a configuration file, or learning JSON syntax, this tool saves you time. Everything runs in your browser — your JSON data never leaves your device.

faq.q: Can I format minified JSON?
faq.a: Yes. Paste minified or single-line JSON and the tool will indent it for readability.

faq.q: Does it validate JSON syntax?

faq.q: Is my JSON data safe to paste here?
faq.a: Yes. Everything runs in your browser. Your JSON is never sent to any server.

tools.name: Base64 Encoder Decoder
tools.summary: Developers constantly encode and decode Base64 for email attachments, data URIs, API authentication tokens, and embedding images in HTML/CSS.
tools.title: Base64 Encoder Decoder — Free Online Base64 Converter
tools.description: Encode and decode Base64 instantly. Convert text to Base64 and back. Free online tool for developers, no signup, works in your browser.
tools.intro: Base64 encoder decoder is a free online tool that converts text to Base64 and back. Base64 is a common encoding format used to represent binary data as plain text, making it safe to transmit over systems that only handle text. Developers use it for embedding images in HTML and CSS, encoding API authentication tokens, sending email attachments, and storing data in JSON. This tool lets you encode any text to Base64 or decode Base64 back to readable text instantly, with no signup and no data leaving your browser.

faq.q: What is Base64 encoding?
faq.a: Base64 is a way to convert binary data into a text format using 64 printable ASCII characters, making it safe for transmission over text-only channels.

faq.q: Is Base64 encoding secure?
faq.a: No. Base64 is encoding, not encryption. Anyone can decode it. It is for data representation, not security.

faq.q: Can I encode images with this tool?
faq.a: This tool works with text. To encode an image, you would first convert it to a Base64 string using a file reader.

tools.name: URL Encoder Decoder
tools.summary: Developers and marketers constantly encode URLs with special characters for query parameters, API calls, and sharing links.
tools.title: URL Encoder Decoder — Free Online URL Encoding Tool
tools.description: Encode and decode URLs instantly. Convert special characters to percent-encoded format and back. Free online URL encoder decoder.
tools.intro: URL encoder decoder is a free online tool that converts URLs between their readable form and percent-encoded format. URLs can only contain a limited set of characters, so special characters like spaces, ampersands, and unicode letters must be encoded as percent-encoded values for use in web addresses. Developers use this tool to prepare query parameters for API calls, fix broken links, and ensure URLs are valid before sharing. Enter any URL or text to encode it, or paste an encoded URL to decode it back to readable form. Everything runs in your browser with no data leaving your device.

faq.q: What is URL encoding?
faq.a: URL encoding converts special characters into a percent sign followed by two hexadecimal digits, making them safe for use in web addresses.

faq.q: When do I need to encode a URL?
faq.a: Encode URLs when they contain spaces, non-ASCII characters, or reserved characters like &, =, or ? that could break the URL structure.

faq.q: Is URL encoding the same as encryption?
faq.a: No. URL encoding is a reversible formatting convention. Anyone can decode an encoded URL.

tools.name: Color Picker
tools.summary: Designers, developers, and digital marketers need to pick colors, convert between formats (hex, RGB, HSL), and match brand colors daily.
tools.title: Color Picker — Free Online Hex, RGB & HSL Converter
tools.description: Pick colors and convert between Hex, RGB, and HSL instantly. Free online color picker with live preview. No signup, works in your browser.
tools.intro: Color picker is a free online tool that lets you visually select colors and convert between Hex, RGB, and HSL formats. Use the visual color picker to find the exact shade you need, or enter a Hex code to see its RGB and HSL equivalents. Designers use this tool to match brand colors, developers use it to get the right color values for CSS, and marketers use it to ensure consistency across digital assets. The tool shows a live preview of your selected color along with copy-ready values for each format. Everything runs in your browser with no signup and no data leaving your device.

faq.q: What is the difference between Hex, RGB, and HSL?
faq.a: Hex is a six-digit code like #FF5733, RGB defines color as red/green/blue values (0-255), and HSL defines it as hue, saturation, and lightness percentages.

faq.q: Can I convert a Hex color to RGB?
faq.a: Yes. Enter any Hex code and the tool instantly shows the equivalent RGB, HSL, and a visual preview.

faq.q: Does this tool work on mobile?
faq.a: Yes. The color picker and all conversions work on any device with a modern web browser.

tools.name: Timestamp Converter
tools.summary: Developers and data analysts constantly convert between Unix timestamps and human-readable dates when working with APIs, databases, and logs.
tools.title: Timestamp Converter — Unix Epoch to Date Converter
tools.description: Convert Unix timestamps to human-readable dates and back. Free online timestamp converter with UTC and local timezone support.
tools.intro: Timestamp converter is a free online tool that converts Unix timestamps to human-readable dates and back. Unix timestamps count the number of seconds or milliseconds since January 1, 1970, and are used everywhere in computing — APIs, databases, log files, and JavaScript all rely on them. But humans cannot read raw timestamps, so developers use this tool to convert them into readable dates and times. Enter a timestamp to see the date in your local timezone and UTC, or enter a date to get its Unix timestamp equivalent. Everything runs in your browser with no signup and no data leaving your device.

faq.q: What is a Unix timestamp?
faq.a: A Unix timestamp is the number of seconds (or milliseconds) that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, also known as the Unix epoch.

faq.q: Does this tool handle milliseconds?
faq.a: Yes. The tool automatically detects whether your timestamp is in seconds or milliseconds and converts accordingly.

faq.q: Can I convert a date to a timestamp?
faq.a: Yes. Enter a date and time, and the tool will show you the equivalent Unix timestamp in both seconds and milliseconds.

tools.name: Lorem Ipsum Generator
tools.summary: Designers and developers constantly need placeholder text for wireframes, mockups, and prototypes before real content is available.
tools.title: Lorem Ipsum Generator — Free Online Dummy Text Tool
tools.description: Generate lorem ipsum placeholder text instantly. Choose the number of paragraphs, sentences, or words. Free online tool, no signup.
tools.intro: Lorem Ipsum generator is a free online tool that creates placeholder text for designers, developers, and content creators. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet is the standard dummy text used in the printing and typesetting industry, and it remains the go-to filler for wireframes, mockups, and prototypes today. This tool lets you generate lorem ipsum text by the paragraph, sentence, or word, so you get exactly the right amount of filler content for your layout. The generated text looks natural and proportional, helping you evaluate design without being distracted by readable content. Everything runs in your browser with no signup.

faq.q: What is lorem ipsum text?
faq.a: Lorem ipsum is dummy text used as a placeholder in design and layout work. It looks like real text but has no meaning, so it does not distract from the design.

faq.q: How many paragraphs can I generate?
faq.a: You can generate up to 20 paragraphs at once, or specify a custom number of sentences or words.

faq.q: Can I use lorem ipsum text in my final product?
faq.a: No. Lorem ipsum is a placeholder. Replace it with real content before publishing.
